description: This file defines the ProjectViewGanttChart class, which extends ViewDetail, and is responsible for rendering a Gantt chart view for projects within the SuiteCRM project management module. It includes display logic, resource retrieval, and HTML/JavaScript code for dynamic Gantt chart interactions.

classes.name: ProjectViewGanttChart
classes.description: A class that manages the display of the Gantt chart view for project management, including rendering resources, project details, and task modals.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main method to render the Gantt chart view, including loads of project data, resources, and embedded HTML/JavaScript for the UI.

methods.name: time_range
methods.description: Calculates and formats the duration between two dates in months and days, used in project duration display.
